title: Crispy Keto Chicken Wings
description: A keto version of the classic Italian-inspired dish, featuring crispy chicken wings with an intense citrus flavor.
instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chicken wings.
In a large bowl, mix together the citrus zest, Italian seasoning blend, and garlic powder.
Toss the chicken wings in the bowl to coat evenly with the seasoning mixture.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken wings in a single layer.
Drizzle the avocado oil over the wings and toss to coat.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the wings start to crisp.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
